answer: Admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch 100 slots are auctioned; newcomers bid deposits, only the highest win, so one operator cannot mint thousands. Winners must finish 10 jobs in 20 epochs along a trellis of referrals, and cheating forfeits the deposit. At the nadir of demand a slot costs $40, so 1,000 fakes cost $40,000 plus 10,000 jobs, more than the reward past that ridge. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
